_about: Ecosystem adoption signals from public APIs and primary announcements. Each figure is a dated snapshot and they are NOT all the same date: the drift-prone fields (stars, npm, PyPI, crates) carry the `captured` date above, while the pinned counts and the named-brand endpoint-probe findings are preserved from their own earlier passes and change only when those passes re-run. Sources inline. Part of the State of UCP Q3 2026 report.

sources.brands_probe: direct GET /.well-known/ucp on 8 named launch partners at their www hosts; re-probed 2026-10-13, earlier probes 2026-07-17 and 2026-08-13. The apex hosts answer 301 to www under the probe policy, so the www host is the one measured.
